1) 从告警标签取 mountpoint 与 server，执行 nfsstat: 1) Take mountpoint and server from the alert labels, run nfsstat -c to confirm the retransmission counters, and check for packet loss to the server with mtr <server>; 2) If the network is clean, run nfsstat -s and iostat -x 1 on the NFS server to see whether its disks or thread count (RPCNFSDCOUNT) are saturated; 3) UDP mounts amplify retransmissions on lossy networks, so confirm the mount options use proto=tcp; 4) Tuning the timeo/retrans mount options only relieves the symptom; the network or server bottleneck must be fixed first.
1) 从告警标签取 mountpoint、server 与 nfsstat_op: 1) Take mountpoint, server, and nfsstat_operation from the alert labels and first determine whether READ or WRITE is slow; 2) Run mountstats <mountpoint> to see the RTT distribution per operation and compare it with the baseline network latency from ping <server>; 3) If network latency is normal, run iostat -x 1 on the server to see whether the backing storage is saturated or another client is running heavy IO; 4) For slow reads consider raising rsize/wsize and enabling actimeo caching; for slow writes check whether the export uses the sync option, which is very expensive.
1) 从告警标签取 mountpoint，执行 mountstats \u003: 1) Take mountpoint from the alert labels and run mountstats <mountpoint> to compare RTT with execute; a large gap means heavy queuing; 2) Heavy queuing usually means concurrent IO exceeds the available RPC slots; raise the mount's nconnect (NFSv4.1+) or the kernel's sunrpc.tcp_slot_table_entries; 3) At the same time check whether a client process is doing large numbers of small-file operations; batching or local caching cuts IOPS dramatically; 4) If RTT is high as well, deal with the server and network via the RTT alert first.
NFS 请求从进入队列到完成的平均耗时超过 100 毫秒。该指标包含客户端排队时: The average NFS request time from queue entry to completion exceeds 100 ms. This metric includes client-side queuing, so a value well above RTT means the client's RPC slots are queuing.
NFS 请求平均 RTT 超过 50 毫秒，说明服务端响应慢或链路时延高，依赖该: The average NFS request RTT exceeds 50 ms, meaning the server is responding slowly or the link latency is high. Applications using this mount will see their IO badly slowed.
NFS 请求平均往返时延过高: NFS average round-trip time too high
NFS 请求平均执行耗时过高: NFS average execute time too high
NFS 请求重传率超过 5%，说明客户端到 NFS 服务端的请求大量超时重发，通: The NFS request retransmission rate exceeds 5%, meaning many requests from the client to the NFS server time out and are resent. This is usually packet loss or an overloaded server, and reads and writes will slow noticeably or hang.
